summary: Wallowa County ranch lookout: a 1931 barn cupola, then a 1933 pole tower run by the Gill brothers as co-operators; the lookout is gone and the land is private.

facts.design: Barn cupola (1931), then a pole tower with a 12x12 platform and 6x6 cab (1933)
facts.agency: Private (Gill family ranch); Forest Service co-operators

staffing.status: volunteer co-operators, the Gill brothers, who took turns on duty

access.note: Private ranch land near Enterprise; the register and firelookout.com both list the site as private

events.note: Cupola built on top of the Gill barn (FFLOS; 1954 history quoted on the Forest Lookouts page)
Gill brothers used the barn cupola as a lookout after the telephone was installed in the fall of 1931
Pole tower built on a slightly higher point. FFLOS and the Irwin history say 1933 (FFLOS 40 feet, Irwin and firelookout.com 36 feet); a June 1936 Forest Service item says winter 1934
Brothers took turns on lookout duty during fire season (Oregonian, October 25, 1937, quoted on the Forest Lookouts page)
Registered November 20, 2019 as US 1843, OR 566; nominated by Tammy McLeod

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and the June 1936 Forest Service item say 40 feet (12.2 m). Firelookout.com and the Irwin 1937 history say 36 feet (11.0 m). The record keeps the register's 40 feet, and the story reports both figures.

FFLOS and firelookout.com give 1933, and the Irwin 1937 history says fall 1933, but a June 1936 Forest Service item puts the decision in the winter of 1934. The story gives 1933 and notes the 1934 account.

notes_for_editor: Brief access 'unknown' is set to private per FFLOS and firelookout.com. Brief built year 1931 and agency Private are confirmed. Tower year and height conflict across sources; the story says so. Most history comes from newspaper and Forest Service material quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, not from the originals. The register's 1935 National Archives panoramas and other photos were not added because no image URLs were extracted.
